requirements.text: As a system, I want to expose a single public webpage so that website visitors can access it without authentication or integration with other systems.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder repeatedly states they want a basic, single-page site with no mention of external systems or integrations.

requirements.text: As a system, I want to operate as a standalone website with no dependencies on external APIs, data imports, or third-party services.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly rejects discussing details like sections or functionality, and no external system is mentioned, implying no integrations are required.

requirements.text: As a system, I want to not require any notification channels for the initial release.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder's insistence on 'bare minimum' and lack of any mention of notifications suggests no integration with external messaging systems is needed.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to view a single webpage about Fundraiser Day so that I can learn about the event's existence.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder agreed with the user story proposed by the analyst that the site must be a single webpage for the event.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to see the name 'Fundraiser Day' prominently displayed on the page so that I immediately understand the site's purpose.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder agreed with the user story that the event name must be prominently shown.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to see a brief, generic description of the event so that I get a basic idea of what it is.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder agreed with the user story that a brief generic description must be included.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to see a simple call-to-action so that I have a clear next step if I am interested.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder agreed with the user story that a call-to-action button must be present.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want the interface to be simple and minimal so that I can quickly understand the event without distraction.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states they want the 'bare minimum' and 'basic site', indicating a clear preference for minimalistic design and interaction.
